attacks.claim: The embargo badge sets its text to #ffffff over var(--surface), which is #ffffff in the default light theme, so the embargo label is invisible to default-theme editors. This defeats the badge's purpose and fails WCAG 1.4.3. The hardcoded color bypasses the token system the diff extends.

The unpublish control is a span with only an onClick handler and an aria-hidden icon. It cannot receive focus, has no role or accessible name, and cannot be activated from the keyboard, so keyboard-only and screen-reader editors cannot unpublish. This conflicts with the WCAG 2.1 AA release requirement (2.1.1, 4.1.2).

The diff does not show a server-side permission check for unpublish. onUnpublish is an injected prop, so the check may live in the endpoint. Confirm it exists before merge, since the client confirm dialog is not an access control.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: server-side authorization for the unpublish call; onUnpublish: (id: string) => Promise<void>

attacks.claim: handleUnpublish has no try/catch, pending or disabled state, or error feedback. A failed request produces an unhandled rejection with no visible signal, and a fast repeat activation could fire duplicate calls.

Unpublish removes a live story, but the diff does not show cache or syndication invalidation. The confirm copy says the story will be removed from the site, which is not verified by anything in the diff.
attacks.evidence: body: `"${draft.headline}" will be removed from the site and returned to drafts.` ; ABSENT: cache invalidation

attacks.claim: No audit entry is recorded for unpublish in this diff. Confirm whether onUnpublish's implementation logs who unpublished what and when, since pulling a published story is a publishing-record event.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: audit or event emission in handleUnpublish or onUnpublish

attacks.claim: The unpublish control is an unlabeled trash icon with no title or tooltip. It suggests deletion while the confirm copy says the story is returned to drafts, which is confusing and easy to mis-hit next to the status pill.
attacks.evidence: <TrashIcon aria-hidden="true" /> used as the Unpublish control, with no title or aria-label

attacks.claim: The embargo lift time is shown without a timezone label, so editors outside the newsroom zone or reading screenshots may misread it.
attacks.evidence: formatInNewsroomTz(draft.embargoUntil!, "MMM d, HH:mm") with no zone suffix

attacks.claim: An unparseable embargoUntil makes the comparison false, so the badge is silently hidden and the embargo state is lost for that row.
attacks.evidence: const embargoed = draft.embargoUntil !== null && new Date(draft.embargoUntil) > new Date();

attacks.claim: The PR makes WCAG and behavioural claims but attaches no contrast ratios, keyboard or screen-reader results, or tests for the embargo logic and unpublish handler.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: contrast measurements for .embargo in both themes, keyboard/AT results, unit tests in PR #644
